vrp-001.title: Variance risk premium (index and single-name)
vrp-001.thesis: Variance risk premium (index and single-name). Currently implemented. See STRATEGY.md.
vrp-001.who_pays: Investors and funds buying downside protection, plus structured-product desks hedging their own books.
vrp-001.why_they_persist: Insurance demand is structural and price-insensitive; mandates require hedging regardless of whether it is expensive this month.
vrp-001.prediction: Implied volatility exceeds subsequently realised volatility on average, so selling defined-risk option structures earns a positive risk-adjusted return net of costs.
vrp-001.kill_criteria: Frictionless straddle capture on real chains below 3%.
vrp-001.data_required: EOD option chains with IV, 15+ years
